caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a brown secretary desk, positioned against a neutral, off-white background. The desk is rectangular with a slanted front panel that serves as a writing surface, featuring a keyhole at the top center. Below the writing surface are four horizontal drawers, each with brass-colored handles and keyholes in the center, and outlined with subtle, thin decorative lines. The desk stands on four cabriole-style legs, with the lower part of the desk front following a curved, decorative line. The appearance of the wood grain is carefully detailed in various shades of brown, with some reddish tones visible on the sides. The handles are symmetrically arranged, two per drawer except for the topmost, which has one handle on each half of a split double drawer. The drawing consists only of the desk, with no additional items or background elements.
title: Desk-White Oak
